name: Tokyo International Airport (Haneda)

runway.v: four runways; the longest, C, is 3,360 m long and 60 m wide

hours.quote: 空港の運用時間は、２４時間とする。

handling.v: business aviation uses dedicated arrival and departure gates with their own customs and immigration
handling.quote: using dedicated CIQ facilities and arrival and departure gates

missing: customs hours (official pages say dedicated CIQ but give no hours)
notes: The website names no companies other than authorities, airport operators and sources, so the handling_list is for internal use only. The Japanese AIP (aisjapan.mlit.go.jp) could not be opened. The runway/outline sheet (tcab-haneda-outline) shows no date. An undated MLIT business jet pamphlet says daytime business jet movements at Haneda are limited to 8 per day; it was not used because it is undated and likely out of date. Japan has no daylight saving time. Re-researched 2026-10-29: Tokyo International Air Terminal Corporation's Business Aviation page lists the Business Aviation Gate in Terminal 3 with 'Hours 24 hours' and 'Private Customs, Immigration, Quarantine facilities', but gives no CIQ hours, so customs was not filled. The Tokyo Metropolitan Government's business-aviation page (undated, registered 22 Oct 2024) says Haneda business-jet slots were raised from 8 to 16 a day in April 2016; this is historical and not a current rule, so it was not used. MLIT's 1 Oct 2026 business-jet application pamphlet could not be opened this time. The Japanese AIP was not reachable (only unofficial mirrors were found, not used).
